name: Status: the status screen shows rank, level and attributes

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
Click 'CONFIRM APPS' on the '[ LOCK TARGETS ]' window (the web build lists no apps; that is expected)
Click 'CONFIRM' on the '[ REST PERIOD ]' window
Click 'HOLD TO ACCEPT' once (this test build accepts a click in place of the hold)
The '[ DAILY QUEST ]' screen is shown with a bottom bar containing 'QUEST', 'STATUS' and 'PENALTY'
A '[ STATUS ]' window shows the rank letter 'E', the label 'RANK', and rows 'LEVEL' with value '1' and 'QUESTS CLEARED' with value '0'
An 'ATTRIBUTES' window shows four attributes labelled 'STR', 'INT', 'DIS' and 'VIT', and 'AVAILABLE POINTS' with value '0'
